facts.text: You boys wanted a perfect evening. I brought the party, the snacks and a very fast car. Eat up.
facts.why: Invented. Lisa's real opening line is 'So...what would you little maniacs like to do first?'
facts.fix: So...what would you little maniacs like to do first?

fix_note.text: So...what would you little maniacs like to do first?

facts.text: Lisa mixes it while Wyatt's parents are away.
facts.why: The plot has the boys drinking at a Chicago blues bar with fake IDs Lisa makes, but no opened source shows Lisa mixing drinks at the house.
facts.fix: Wyatt's parents are away, so Lisa takes charge.

facts.text: Lisa appearing in the bathroom steam
facts.why: The plot says a power surge creates Lisa but does not say where she appears. The quote page only has a shower line.
facts.fix: Lisa appearing after the power surge

vibe.verdict: The Wyatt's house setting and blues bar food fit, but the prom night layout is not from this film and the best gags are missing.
missing: The pink Cadillac Eldorado Lisa conjures (trip to the blues bar)
Bras on their heads in the creation scene ('Ceremonial')
Chet turned into a toad creature (morning after)
Mutant bikers crashing the party (house party)
The missile coming up through the roof (house party)
Wyatt's grandparents frozen in the kitchen cupboard
ideas: Swap 'Salt and vinegar chips with onion dip' note for a Cadillac Eldorado pink lemonade
Replace 'Big brother Chet's party sheet cake' with 'Chet the toad' green frosted cake
Swap the 'Prom night' header for a 'Wyatt's basement lab' header with printout paper
Swap 'Cocktail sausage rolls' note for 'Bras on heads. Ceremonial.'
